title: Develop and validate data migration scripts
description: As a developer, I want to develop two migration scripts - one for extracting data from Old PMIS and one for updating data after the old system is switched off - so that data is accurately and completely transferred to e-PMIS
acceptance_criteria: Script 1 extracts all relevant data from Old PMIS. Script 2 updates current workflow in e-PMIS with verified static data after switch-off. Both scripts are tested before running against production. Execution logs are available for audit.
